I was standing in his front yard. He and his wife were standing in the back yard. It was at about 11 o'clock at night. Above his house to the left about three houses over there was an orange glowing ball hovering in the sky. Now, I never saw it. I never did look up and by the time my bother got my attention it was gone. He said it floated about 75 feet in the sky. He said he could very clearly see that it wasn't a light, or a Chinese lantern, or a RC helicopter with a balloon glued to it, or anything like that. He said it was just this orange glowing perfect sphere with a smoothly textured surface. He said it was pretty big too. About the same size as a large truck or even a little bigger. He said it floated along above the houses until it got above his house (taking about a minute or two). He said it then dropped down to about 30 feet very slowly above his head (taking about 30 seconds) before almost instantly flying away into the distant sky at near the speed of light (taking about a nano second). All while making no sounds at all. I asked him to describe the sudden disappearance and he said the only way to describe it was it flew away in a straight line off into the sky off into space at what was a near impossible speed. So fast it would have killed any human occupant. Because he said you could see it but it was flying so fast if you'd have blinked you'd have missed it. Now, the good part of this story is he had his camera in his hand. But, the bad part is all of his pictures look like shit. You can't make out the object at all. They all make it look like a simple orange blurry dot. You can't tell how far away it is or how big it is. You just see a blurry dot. So, they're really quite useless. He is furious with himself to this day that he didn't think of switching over to HD video mode. Because that would have been a million times better than some blurry pictures. But, he didn't. This genuinely freaked him out. He swore to me every detail of his story was exactly as he said. Besides he had the pictures to show me he wasn't crazy. So I know he's not crazy. I'll never forgive myself for not looking up. I could have seen it to. We talked about it all night. This was the first and only UFO either of us have ever seen. I've never seen one. Has anyone else ever seen this kind of UFO before? What the hell did my brother see that night?

Family tradition to make candy every year during the holidays. Goes back well over 100 years now. Here is our current fudge recipe.

  • 3 Cups Sugar
  • 3/4 Cup Butter (1 & 1/2 cubes)
  • 1 Cup Heavy Cream (Whipping)
  • 1/4 tsp Cream of Tartar
  • 2 Cups Chocolate Chips (12 oz)
  • 2 Cups Miniture Marshmallows (7 oz jar Marshmallow Cream) Make sure they're fresh!!!!!
  • 1 tsp Real Vanilla

Add the Cream of Tartar to the Sugar, and stir it in.

In a heavy sauce pan, melt the Butter on med heat. As the butter melts, rub it all around the sides of the pan.

Add in the Cream and stir till mixed.

Add the Sugar mix and mix well, keep stirring.

Take time to bring to a boil. After it begins to boil, quit stirring.

Then put the thermometer in the pan.

Cook till it reaches 234 deg. F. Leave on stove, turn off burner.

Remove the thermometer.

Mix in the Marshmallows and Chocolate.

When melted, add the Vanilla. Keep stirring till all is well mixed and smooth.

Keep folding till it starts to set. Pour into a Lightly greased 9"x9" silicone pans.

When cool, turn out onto cutting board and cut into 1" squares.

Store in airtight container with wax paper between layers.
